name: vibe-coding-workflow-system

scripts.gen:all: bun run gen:workflow-skills && bun run gen:workflow-docs && bun run gen:registry
scripts.validate:vnext-runtime: bun run build:vnext-runtime && bun run scripts/vnext-runtime.ts validate-contract --root .
scripts.test:workflow-vnext-shadow: bun test test/project-context-resolver.test.ts test/workflow-review-shadow.test.ts test/workflow-validate-shadow.test.ts test/workflow-shadow-samples.test.ts

scripts.test:workflow-vnext-bootstrap: bun run build:vnext-runtime && bun test test/vnext-bootstrap-project.test.ts

scripts.test:workflow-docs: bun run gen:workflow-docs --dry-run && bun test test/gen-workflow-docs.test.ts
scripts.test:registry: bun run gen:registry --dry-run && bun test test/gen-registry.test.ts
